title: console: six user-visible defects from objectstack's full platform-checklist run — untranslated Studio nav labels, machine ids in a toast, chips and banners, disabled controls with no reason, hard-coded English settings badges
body:
**Filing gate ①** — user-visible defects at public surfaces, each reproduced twice on a fresh load by objectstack's full platform-checklist run (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23878, report comment 6216814713), each code path re-checked on objectui `main` `d66ceea5` (still present). **Filed by** the objectstack `domain:devx` seat 1 PM (objectstack seat post #6023) · `os-sales` · `session_014eFvbvGK4FjXvscggDNTD4`, because the runner's session was refused a cross-repository create. Six items in one card: the filing seat's per-round quota is three, and its overflow rule folds the rest into one card with a list — split them as this repository's triage sees fit. ⛔ Not a claim; lanes and grades are this repository's triage.

**Reader who acts:** this repository's triage, then the seats owning `packages/app-shell` and `apps/console`.

Run context: objectstack `2034975a`, console at `.objectui-sha` `daeb77fc` (built against spec `a35f7a67^`, because the pin does not build on objectstack main — objectstack-ai/objectstack#23908).

## The items

1. **Studio Interfaces nav rail and dashboard component list stay English on a zh-CN session** (item `i18n.studio-follows-app-locale`, clause 1). The labels exist in the app's translation bundle. Cause read by the runner: `navItemLabelText` resolves inline `I18nLabel` maps only, and the rail reads `/meta/app/APP/layers`, the code layer. Repro: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23951.
2. **The Discard-draft toast and its confirm name the machine id** — "Draft discarded: object/uxscratch_widget" — although the item has a label (item `ux-conventions.write-feedback`, clause 1). Source: `ResourceEditPage.tsx`, key `engine.edit.draftDiscarded`; the objectui#12303 pin asserts this string. Repro: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23953.
3. **About 20 disabled controls in the Studio Validations editor on a read-only package give no reason** — no hover text, no keyboard path, no aria description (item `ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason`, clauses 0–2). objectui#12303 covered only the Field-properties inspector. Repro: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23953.
4. **Explain access shows machine names** — the Principal position and permission-set chips and the result banner (`org_member`, `showcase_member_default`, `Read on "uxscratch_widget"`) (item `ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names`, clause 0 (a)). Outside the closed objectui#11862. Repro: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23953.
5. **Studio Interfaces list-view "Columns" chips show field api names** (`title`, `owner_ref`) instead of field labels (same item, clause 0 (b)). Repro: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23953.
6. **Settings badges are hard-coded English**: `apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsField.tsx` renders `Overrides` and `Inherited from` untranslated, so a zh-CN session reads "Overrides 默认". Repro: switch to zh-CN, save a tenant value under Settings → Localization, open `/_console/apps/setup/system/settings/localization`. (Seen on a passing variant of `i18n.surface-matrix`.)

Unverified observations from the same runner, not part of this card: the kanban drag-and-drop live region announces raw record and column ids; the approvals drawer shows position names (`finance 0/1 · manager`); the approval inbox body names a raw record id; the empty Interfaces heading uses the package id.

## Done when

Each item shows the label (or the locale's translation) where it shows a machine name or English today, item 3 gives each disabled control a reason reachable by hover, keyboard and assistive technology, and each fix carries a pin that fails against today's render.

## Dedupe

Run by the runner with MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included, recorded in its report: item 1 "Studio Interfaces nav rail labels not translated zh-CN app navigation translation bundle" → 60 hits, none matching; item 2 → 3 hits, none matching; item 3 → 11 hits, none matching; item 5 → 5 hits, none matching; item 6 → 6 hits, none matching; item 4 checked against objectui#11862 (closed, different surface).

Dedupe words: machine id shown instead of label; Studio nav untranslated zh-CN; disabled control no reason; settings badge hard-coded English.
